versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיִקְחוּ־לִ֖י תְּרוּמָ֑ה מֵאֵ֤ת כָּל־אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדְּבֶ֣נּוּ לִבּ֔וֹ תִּקְח֖וּ אֶת־תְּרוּמָתִֽי׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
controles.livre: Dize aos filhos de Israel que tomem para mim oferta: de todo homem que a der de sua vontade, de coração, tomareis minha oferta.

versos.hebraico: וְזֹאת֙ הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּקְח֖וּ מֵאִתָּ֑ם זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, brass,
controles.kjv: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
controles.livre: E esta é a oferta que tomareis deles: Ouro, e prata, e bronze,

versos.hebraico: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃

controles.web: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
controles.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
controles.livre: E material azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho fino, e pelo de cabras,

versos.hebraico: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּֽים׃

controles.web: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
controles.kjv: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
controles.livre: E couros de carneiros tingidos de vermelho, e couros finos, e madeira de acácia;

versos.hebraico: שֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּאֹ֑ר בְּשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃

controles.web: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
controles.kjv: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
controles.livre: Azeite para a luminária, especiarias para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático;

versos.hebraico: אַבְנֵי־שֹׁ֕הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפֹ֖ד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

controles.web: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
controles.kjv: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
controles.livre: Pedras de ônix, e pedras de engastes, para o éfode, e para o peitoral.

versos.hebraico: וְעָ֥שׂוּ לִ֖י מִקְדָּ֑שׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

controles.web: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
controles.kjv: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
controles.livre: E farão para mim um santuário, e eu habitarei entre eles.

versos.hebraico: כְּכֹ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתְךָ֔ אֵ֚ת תַּבְנִ֣ית הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת תַּבְנִ֣ית כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְכֵ֖ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס

controles.web: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.
controles.kjv: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
controles.livre: Conforme tudo o que eu te mostrar, o desenho do tabernáculo, e o desenho de todos os seus objetos, assim o fareis.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֲר֖וֹן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֨צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its breadth a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
controles.kjv: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
controles.livre: Farão também uma arca de madeira de acácia, cujo comprimento será de dois côvados e meio, e sua largura de côvado e meio, e sua altura de côvado e meio.

versos.hebraico: וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ תְּצַפֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עָלָ֛יו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
controles.livre: E a cobrirás de ouro puro; por dentro e por fora a cobrirás; e farás sobre ela uma borda de ouro ao redor.

versos.hebraico: וְיָצַ֣קְתָּ לּ֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

controles.web: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
controles.livre: E para ela farás de fundição quatro anéis de ouro, que porás a seus quatro cantos; dois anéis ao um lado dela, e dois anéis ao outro lado.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בַדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
controles.livre: E farás umas varas de madeira de acácia, as quais cobrirás de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וְהֵֽבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֥את אֶת־הָאָרֹ֖ן בָּהֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
controles.livre: E meterás as varas pelos anéis aos lados da arca, para levar a arca com elas.

versos.hebraico: בְּטַבְּעֹת֙ הָאָרֹ֔ן יִהְי֖וּ הַבַּדִּ֑ים לֹ֥א יָסֻ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
controles.kjv: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
controles.livre: As varas se estarão nos anéis da arca: não se tirarão dela.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֖ אֶל־הָאָרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָעֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You shall put the testimony which I shall give you into the ark.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
controles.livre: E porás no arca o testemunho que eu te darei.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ כַפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֨צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
controles.livre: E farás uma coberta de ouro fino, cujo comprimento será de dois côvados e meio, e sua largura de côvado e meio.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ שְׁנַ֥יִם כְּרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃

controles.web: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
controles.livre: Farás também dois querubins de ouro, lavrados a martelo os farás, nas duas extremidades do propiciatório.

versos.hebraico: וַ֠עֲשֵׂה כְּר֨וּב אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.
controles.kjv: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
controles.livre: Farás, pois, um querubim ao extremo de um lado, e um querubim ao outro extremo do lado oposto: da qualidade do propiciatório farás os querubins em suas duas extremidades.

versos.hebraico: וְהָי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו אֶל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת יִהְי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃

controles.web: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.
controles.kjv: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
controles.livre: E os querubins estenderão por encima as asas, cobrindo com suas asas o propiciatório: suas faces a uma em frente da outra, olhando ao propiciatório as faces dos querubins.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֧ אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶל־הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I will give you.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
controles.livre: E porás o propiciatório encima da arca, e no arca porás o testemunho que eu te darei.

versos.hebraico: וְנוֹעַדְתִּ֣י לְךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְדִבַּרְתִּ֨י אִתְּךָ֜ מֵעַ֣ל הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת מִבֵּין֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת אֵ֣ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֲצַוֶּ֛ה אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the testimony, all that I command you for the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E dali me declararei a ti, e falarei contigo de sobre o propiciatório, dentre os dois querubins que estão sobre a arca do testemunho, tudo o que eu te mandarei para os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ שֻׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Two cubits shall be its length, and a cubit its breadth, and one and a half cubits its height.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
controles.livre: Farás também uma mesa de madeira de acácia: seu comprimento será de dois côvados, e de um côvado sua largura, e sua altura de côvado e meio.

versos.hebraico: וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
controles.livre: E a cobrirás de ouro puro, e lhe farás uma borda de ouro ao redor.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לּ֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ זֵר־זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: You shall make a rim of a hand breadth around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
controles.livre: Farás também para ele também uma moldura ao redor, da largura de uma mão, à qual moldura farás uma borda de ouro ao redor.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃

controles.web: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
controles.livre: E lhe farás quatro anéis de ouro, os quais porás aos quatro cantos que correspondem a seus quatro pés.

versos.hebraico: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

controles.web: the rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.
controles.kjv: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
controles.livre: Os anéis estarão antes da moldura, por lugares das varas, para levar a mesa.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְנִשָּׂא־בָ֖ם אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

controles.web: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
controles.livre: E farás as varas de madeira de acácia, e as cobrirás de ouro, e com elas será levada a mesa.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ קְּעָרֹתָ֜יו וְכַפֹּתָ֗יו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו֙ וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls to pour out offerings with. You shall make them of pure gold.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
controles.livre: Farás também seus pratos, e suas colheres, e seus jarros, e suas bacias, com que se fará libações: de ouro fino os farás.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֧ עַֽל־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן לֶ֥חֶם פָּנִ֖ים לְפָנַ֥י תָּמִֽיד׃פ

controles.web: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
controles.livre: E porás sobre a mesa o pão da proposição diante de mim continuamente.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מְנֹרַ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה תֵּעָשֶׂ֤ה הַמְּנוֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃

controles.web: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. Of hammered work shall the lamp stand be made, even its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers, shall be of one piece with it.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
controles.livre: Farás também um candelabro de ouro puro; lavrado a martelo se fará o candelabro: seu pé, e sua cana, seus copos, seus botões, e suas flores, serão do mesmo:

versos.hebraico: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

controles.web: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;
controles.kjv: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
controles.livre: E sairão seis braços de seus lados: três braços do candelabro do um lado seu, e três braços do candelabro do outro seu lado:

versos.hebraico: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בַּקָּנֶ֥ה הָאֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃

controles.web: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;
controles.kjv: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
controles.livre: Três copos em forma de amêndoas em um braço, um botão e uma flor; e três copos, forma de amêndoas no outro braço, um botão e uma flor: assim, pois, nos seis braços que saem do candelabro:

versos.hebraico: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
controles.kjv: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
controles.livre: E no candelabro quatro copos em forma de amêndoas, seus botões e suas flores.

versos.hebraico: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּחַת־שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֨שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃

controles.web: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
controles.kjv: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
controles.livre: Haverá um botão debaixo dos dois braços do mesmo, outro botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, e outra botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, em conformidade aos seis braços que saem do candelabro.

versos.hebraico: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה יִהְי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.
controles.kjv: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
controles.livre: Seus botões e seus braços serão do mesmo, todo ele uma peça lavrada a martelo, de ouro puro.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱלָה֙ אֶת־נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְהֵאִ֖יר עַל־עֵ֥בֶר פָּנֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
controles.livre: E farás para ele sete lâmpadas, as quais acenderás para que iluminem à parte de sua dianteira:

versos.hebraico: וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.
controles.kjv: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
controles.livre: Também suas tenazes e seus apagadores, de ouro puro.

versos.hebraico: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.
controles.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
controles.livre: De um talento de ouro fino o farás, com todos estes objetos.

versos.hebraico: וּרְאֵ֖ה וַעֲשֵׂ֑ה בְּתַ֨בְנִיתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה מָרְאֶ֖ה בָּהָֽר׃ס

controles.web: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
controles.kjv: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
controles.livre: E olha, e faze-os conforme seu modelo, que te foi mostrado no monte.
